note: The opportunity matrix: customer intent x service x market, scored against who owns the answer today and what Wolff can credibly claim. score = demand (1-5) x fit to Wolff's model (1-5) x winnability vs incumbent (1-5), max 125. This file drives prioritization; the console sorts by it. Sources: research/profile-and-plan.md intents 1-6, the audit's competitor findings, data/questions.json clusters.
